mapper.select: SELECT oi.id, oi.order_id, oi.product_sku_id, oi.product_id, oi.sku_code, oi.product_name, COALESCE(ps.spec_attributes, oi.sku_name) AS sku_name, COALESCE(ps.sku_image, oi.product_image) AS product_image, oi.original_price, ps.original_price AS market_price, oi.quantity, oi.apportioned_discount, oi.final_price FROM order_items oi LEFT JOIN product_skus ps ON oi.product_sku_id = ps.id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId} AND oi.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY oi.created_time

SELECT oi.id AS id, oi.order_id AS orderId, oi.product_sku_id AS productSkuId, oi.product_id AS productId, oi.sku_code AS skuCode, oi.product_name AS productName, oi.product_image AS productImage, oi.sku_name AS skuName, oi.quantity AS quantity, oi.original_price AS originalPrice, ps.original_price AS marketPrice, oi.apportioned_discount AS apportionedDiscount, oi.final_price AS finalPrice, oi.created_time AS createdTime, oi.updated_time AS updatedTime, oi.created_by AS createdBy, oi.updated_by AS updatedBy, oi.is_deleted AS isDeleted, oi.deleted_time AS deletedTime FROM order_items oi LEFT JOIN product_skus ps ON oi.product_sku_id = ps.id WHERE oi.product_sku_id = #{productSkuId} AND oi.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY oi.created_time DESC
